Explicit window batching gives independent representations exactly: for every valid training position t, gather the suffix ending at t, truncate to W items, left-pad to the inference input length, assign the same absolute position IDs as inference, run all causal layers, and retain the final-slot output. Share parameters across windows; recompute hidden states within each window. This follows from [SASRec’s learned positional embeddings](https://github.com/kang205/SASRec/blob/master/model.py). For B sequences, T endpoints, D layers and width d, derived dense compute is O(BTD(W²d + Wd²)), assuming input length W. Conventional saved activations scale as O(BTD(Wd + hW²)) for h attention heads.

Checkpointing preserves this computation while trading saved activations for backward recomputation; use `use_reentrant=False`, consistent masks, and preserved dropout RNG. Exact numerical agreement with a reference also requires matching stochastic masks. Checkpoint whole window chunks, preferably accepting integer sequences and constructing embeddings inside, to avoid retaining expanded embeddings. Chunking alone does not bound autograd memory if all chunk graphs remain attached until one backward. Instead, backpropagate each correctly normalized chunk loss immediately, accumulate gradients, and step once; peak activation memory then depends on chunk size. Checkpointing adds recomputation without changing asymptotic arithmetic. See [PyTorch checkpoint documentation](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/checkpoint/).

Local attention is generally inequivalent. A token needs different absolute embeddings in different endpoint windows; additionally, intermediate keys/values can carry information from before the target window. Stacking D causal local layers expands the receptive field to approximately D(W−1)+1, consistent with [Longformer’s analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.05150). Genuine sparse kernels reduce attention compute/storage to O(BDTWd)/O(BDThW), plus projections and feed-forward costs; a dense masked implementation retains quadratic costs. Thus explicit windows plus chunked backward/checkpointing are feasible exact approaches; local masking changes the model.
